newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish May paper output highest this decade - SF.
newsitem.headline: Finnish May paper output highest this decade - SF.

text.p: The volume of Finnish paper and pulp output adjusted for workdays rose 19.5 percent year-on-year in May and paper production was the highest this decade, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Paper production in May..was by volume the highest this decade," it said.
It said double-digit growth in paper output and in construction related production boosted the industrial output index, which rose 6.1 percent year-on-year.
Construction related industry output rose 21 percent year-on-year and building materials output was nearing its previous peak achieved in 1990, SF said.

Total May paper and pulp industry output growth was up 17.9 percent year-on-year, while metal industry output rose 7.1 percent, chemical industry output increased 1.7 percent and other industry production rose 3.1 percent, it said.
